name: My Weather
subtitle: Updates for My Weather
description: Updates for the My Weather app.

apps.name: My Weather
apps.subtitle: Minimal weather, with widgets.
apps.localizedDescription: A minimal weather app with Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets, rain alerts, SHMÚ warnings and a morning briefing. In English and Slovak.

versions.localizedDescription: Security: safer handling of place names, stricter app security policy, encrypted SHMÚ warnings.
Widget shows the last real weather when offline (up to 12 hours), smaller app.
More reliable: never stuck loading, refreshes when reopened, real GPS for the locate button, offline weather for every saved city, no double morning notification. Moon icons at night.
Small square widgets for UV, rain, wind, humidity, air and sunrise/sunset on the Home Screen.
New Lock Screen widgets (UV, rain, wind, humidity, air, sunrise/sunset), easier-to-read hourly graph, and in-app update notices.

privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: My Weather uses your location to show the forecast for where you actually are, and to switch cities automatically as you travel.
